title: Cover federation journal refusal envelopes and stale scan observation boundaries
outcome: Focused journal regressions cover refusal code/restart/role fields, identity-unavailable503, cursor domain changes, incomplete scan prefixes, replaced/deleted cached obligations and bounded metadata branches.
acceptance: Focused journal regressions assert refusal code/restart/role fields, identity-unavailable 503, cursor-domain changes and final basis revalidation, incomplete scan prefixes, cached-obligation deletion/replacement/retargeting, and the 4096-byte binding and 16384-byte sender/topic metadata boundaries, without exposing private values or mutating production read behavior.
The combined follow-up input has a passing maintained five-stage full gate and an independent Codex plus Claude read-only review pair with no outstanding in-scope Medium-or-higher finding.
